descript.abstract: NASA's Planetary Data System Geosciences Node Mola PEDR Query Results Shapefile This Point shapefile is a special product generated from selected MOLA PEDR records where each Point is a MOLA PEDR Point. The product was generated by the NASA Planetary Data System - Geosciences Node's Orbital Data Explorer tool based on a set of user input parameters: The file(s) were generated at 2026-11-13T10:28:35.028 with the following query parameters: Min Lat: 21.99 Max Lat: 22.33 Westernmost Lon: 341.82 Easternmost Lon: 342.28 Links: NASA Planetary Data System: http://pds.jpl.nasa.gov/ Geosciences Node: http://geo.pds.nasa.gov/ Orbital Data Explorer: http://ode.rsl.wustl.edu/
